fields.name: HTML
fields.description:
Welcome to SMP@NOAC!
Our goal here is simple: We want to hear your favorite memory from this year???s conference. If you have just a moment, we???d love for you to share a short video clip to tell us who you are, where you???re from and what your favorite story or memory has been so far during NOAC.
Participation is simple! Just click on the ???NEXT??? button below, fill out a short form, and follow the on-screen directions! You???ll use the camera on your phone or laptop to answer a couple of on-screen questions with short video clips. We???ll edit those together and save them as part of our NOAC 2022 Memory Box.

About the Scouting Memories Project
The Scouting Memories Project is a joint effort between the Order of the Arrow, the National Scouting Museum, and BSA Alumni, and is officially chartered by the Boy Scouts of America. The project seeks to collect and preserve history and personal Scouting stories from more than 1 million current members and 100 million alumni.
